exercise_revision_provenance_shape_check.name: exercise_revision_provenance_shape_check
exercise_revision_provenance_shape_check.value:
(
        ("exercise_revision"."origin_kind" = 'internally_curated' AND "exercise_revision"."primary_provenance_reference_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("exercise_revision"."origin_kind" = 'derived_from_public_locator' AND "exercise_revision"."primary_provenance_reference_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

privacy_audit_event_reason_code_denied_c.name: privacy_audit_event_reason_code_denied_check
privacy_audit_event_reason_code_denied_c.value:
(
        ("privacy_audit_event"."outcome" = 'denied' AND "privacy_audit_event"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("privacy_audit_event"."outcome" = 'succeeded' AND "privacy_audit_event"."reason_code" IS NULL) OR
        ("privacy_audit_event"."outcome" IN ('failed', 'partial'))
      )

privacy_subject_request_verification_pai.name: privacy_subject_request_verification_pair_check
privacy_subject_request_verification_pai.value:
(
        ("privacy_subject_request"."verification_ref_digest" IS NULL AND "privacy_subject_request"."verification_synthetic" IS NULL) OR
        ("privacy_subject_request"."verification_ref_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "privacy_subject_request"."verification_synthetic" IS NOT NULL)
      )

taxonomy_term_replacement_shape_check.name: taxonomy_term_replacement_shape_check
taxonomy_term_replacement_shape_check.value:
(
        ("taxonomy_term"."lifecycle" = 'replaced' AND "taxonomy_term"."replaced_by_term_id" IS NOT NULL AND "taxonomy_term"."replaced_by_term_id" <> "taxonomy_term"."id")
        OR
        ("taxonomy_term"."lifecycle" <> 'replaced' AND "taxonomy_term"."replaced_by_term_id" IS NULL)
      )
